experiment_name: 30-day Binance demo USDT-perpetual futures paper trading experiment
note: Checks follow crypto activity in Asia/Kuala_Lumpur time: hourly through the US-session peak (20:00 to 23:00), then 00:00 and 02:00, plus 09:00 (Asia morning) and 16:00 (Europe open), on thirty consecutive calendar days, with a daily review at 22:00 (see REVIEW-PROMPT.md). The trading day for loss limits runs 06:00 to 06:00. Stops and targets rest on the demo exchange between checks.

tasks.label: Session check 00:00
instructions: Read AGENTS.md, strategy, schedule, continuity, readiness, current-state, latest journal and reviews/LESSONS.md.
Let the engine reconcile any stop or target the demo exchange triggered since the last check.
Manage an open position: hold, or close when the thesis is invalid; positions are closed after 24 hours.
With no position, a new long or short entry is allowed only with at least two independent evidence categories.
Record the decision, evidence, holdings, cash, risk and next focus. Demo account only.
